scripts.start: npm run docs && concurrently "wp-scripts start --webpack-src-dir=src/scss --output-path=assets/css" "npm run watch:readme" "npm run watch:docs"
scripts.build: npm run docs && wp-scripts build --webpack-src-dir=src/scss --output-path=assets/css && npm run copy:readme
scripts.theme-zip: npm run build && npm run copy:readme && zip -r lumina-theme.zip . -x "*.DS_Store" "node_modules/*" "zz_unused/*" ".git*" "src/*" "package*" "webpack*" "postcss*" "readme.md"
scripts.watch:docs: concurrently --names "PHP,SCSS,PTRN,PRTS,TMPL,VARS,UTIL" -c "yellow,cyan,green,magenta,blue,red,white" "npm run watch:docs-php" "npm run watch:docs-scss" "npm run watch:docs-patterns" "npm run watch:docs-parts" "npm run watch:docs-templates" "npm run watch:docs-variables" "npm run watch:docs-scripts"
scripts.docs: npm run docs:php && npm run docs:scss && npm run docs:patterns && npm run docs:parts && npm run docs:templates && npm run docs:variables && npm run docs:scripts
